## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 33. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

Adam Burke opens with the surface reading and then dismantles it. On the surface, this looks like a great hire: Candle went 81-44 at Toledo and had no problems succeeding Matt Campbell with the newfound success he brought to the Rockets. At the same time, he notes, Candle only won the MAC twice in 10 seasons as head coach and owns a career bowl record of 3-5 — not to mention the Rockets' penchant for losing games as a big favorite, losing more than 10 times as a TD-plus favorite from 2021-25. His balance is situational: on the plus side, Candle won't see a lot of big favorite roles with the Huskies; on the downside, a programme like UConn simply has to win games in which they are favored, and Candle has had major problems doing just that.
